import os,socket,json,hashlib,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
assert socket.gethostname()=='Agilex7Workstation' and os.getuid()==1000
root=Path('/opt/altera/26.1.1/quartus');r={}
for s in ['common/help/webhelp','common/enum']:
 d=root/s;r[s]=[(str(p.relative_to(d)),p.stat().st_size) for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file()][:150]
p=root/'linux64/libdb_acf.so';b=p.read_bytes()
# Capture raw references to assignment string: nearby static table pointer words.
import struct
needle=b'ROUTER_LCELL_INSERTION_AND_LOGIC_DUPLICATION';offset=b.index(needle);ptr=struct.pack('<Q',offset)
r['assignment_offset']=offset;r['pointer_occurrences']=[]
for m in re.finditer(re.escape(ptr),b):
 start=max(0,m.start()-128);z=b[start:m.start()+256];words=[]
 for i in range(0,len(z)-7,8):
  v=struct.unpack_from('<Q',z,i)[0];t=''
  if 0<v<len(b):
   q=b[v:v+500].split(b'\0')[0]
   if q and all(32<=c<127 for c in q):t=q.decode()
  words.append([start+i,hex(v),t])
 r['pointer_occurrences'].append(words)
payload=json.dumps(r).encode();subprocess.run(['tmux','load-buffer','-b','msa-router-341cc500cf29','-'],input=payload,check=True)
